title: KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans — Price Schedule and Renewal Pricing
content:
The list price of each KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans level is the plan price before any renewal discount, in US dollars. Every level may be financed, may be bought again as a renewal, and carries the same renewal discount and renewal window.

## Schedule by plan level

| Plan level | List price (USD) | Price may be financed with the vehicle | New plan may be bought after this one ends | Renewal discount off the list price | Renewal window (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| KestrelCare Maintenance Starter | 399.00 | Yes | Yes | 5 percent | 30 |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Basic | 549.00 | Yes | Yes | 5 percent | 30 |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Standard | 699.00 | Yes | Yes | 5 percent | 30 |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Plus | 999.00 | Yes | Yes | 5 percent | 30 |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Premier | 1299.00 | Yes | Yes | 5 percent | 30 |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Premier Max | 1549.00 | Yes | Yes | 5 percent | 30 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. **Financing.** "Yes" in the financing column means the plan price may be included in a Kestrel Auto Finance contract signed with the vehicle.
2. **Renewal.** "Yes" in the renewal column means a new plan may be bought once the current plan is fulfilled or expired.
3. **Renewal discount.** The renewal discount is a discount of 5 percent off the list price of a plan bought within 30 calendar days after the previous plan on the same VIN was fulfilled or expired. The discount is taken once, off the list price of the plan being bought.

## Hypothetical price illustration

The figures below are example inputs chosen for illustration; they are not a quotation.

| Plan being bought | List price | Bought within the renewal window | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| KestrelCare Maintenance Standard | 699.00 | No | 699.00 |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Standard | 699.00 | Yes | 699.00 less 5 percent of 699.00 (34.95), which is 664.05 |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Premier Max | 1549.00 | Yes | 1549.00 less 5 percent of 1549.00 (77.45), which is 1471.55 |
